license_required.quote: Only an individual who has received a license to practice or qualifies for a practice privilege shall be styled and known as a "certified public accountant."

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Accountancy

age_minimum.quote: Is no less than eighteen (18) years of age

degree_required.value: baccalaureate or master's degree with major or concentration in accounting
degree_required.quote: Has a baccalaureate degree or master's degree conferred by a college or university recognized by the board with a major or concentration in accounting or its equivalent

accrediting_body.value: college or university recognized by the board
accrediting_body.quote: conferred by a college or university recognized by the board

required.quote: Obtains one (1) year of accounting or attest experience while employed in an accounting or auditing position in public practice, industry, or government

duration.quote: Obtains one (1) year of accounting or attest experience

kind.value: accounting or attest experience in public practice, industry, or government
kind.quote: accounting or attest experience while employed in an accounting or auditing position in public practice, industry, or government

exams.name: Uniform CPA Examination
exams.notes: Board-approved examination in accounting, auditing, and other related subjects; candidate must satisfy age, moral character, and education requirements before sitting
exams.quote: Passes a board-approved examination in accounting, auditing, and other related subjects as the board deems appropriate

interval_years.quote: Licenses shall be initially issued and renewed for a period of two (2) years

required.quote: Fulfilled the requirement of continuing professional education as defined by the board by administrative regulation, but not to exceed eighty (80) hours during a two (2) year calendar period

hours_per_period.quote: not to exceed eighty (80) hours during a two (2) year calendar period ending December 31 preceding the August 1 renewal date

period_years.quote: eighty (80) hours during the two (2) year calendar period ending December 31 preceding the August 1 renewal date

available.quote: The board may issue a license to practice by reciprocity

requirements.value: Applicant must satisfy the educational requirement in KRS 325.261(3), receive a passing grade on the Uniform CPA Examination in another state, hold a valid active license in good standing as a CPA from another state, and meet current experience requirements or have four years of experience in the preceding ten years.
requirements.quote: Satisfies the educational requirement in KRS 325.261(3); Receives a grade on the Uniform CPA Examination in another state that was equivalent to a passing grade at the time in this Commonwealth; Holds a valid active license, and is in good standing as a certified public accountant, issued under the laws of any other state

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall assume or use the title or designation "certified public accountant," "public accountant," or the abbreviation "CPA" or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the person is a certified public accountant, unless the person holds a license issued under this chapter or qualifies for a practice privilege under KRS 325.282.

title_protection.quote: No person shall assume or use the title or designation "certified public accountant," "public accountant," or the abbreviation "CPA" or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the person is a certified public accountant, unless the person holds a license issued under this chapter or qualifies for a practice privilege under KRS 325.282.

scope_protection.quote: No person or firm shall sign or affix his or her name or a firm name to any document or prepare or issue any document which indicates that the person or firm performed attest services or that includes any language which indicates that the person or the firm has expert knowledge in performing attest services, unless the person or firm holds a license to practice issued under this chapter or is exempt from having to obtain a license pursuant to KRS 325.301.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a license issued under this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a license issued under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud, or negligence while performing any regulated activity, including fiscal dishonesty or intentional breach of fiduciary responsibility
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud, or negligence while performing any regulated activity, including fiscal dishonesty or an intentional breach of fiduciary responsibility of any kind

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowing preparation, publication, or dissemination of false, fraudulent, or materially misleading financial statements, reports, or information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowing preparation, publication, or dissemination of false, fraudulent, or materially misleading financial statements, reports, or information

disciplinary_grounds.description: Embezzlement, theft, misappropriation of funds or property, or obtaining money or property by fraudulent means
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Embezzlement, theft, misappropriation of funds or property, or obtaining money, property, or other valuable consideration by fraudulent means or false pretenses

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this chapter, administrative regulations, or any order of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any of the provisions of this chapter or administrative regulations promulgated by the board under this chapter or violation of any order of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a rule of professional conduct promulgated by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of a rule of professional conduct promulgated by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any felony or any crime involving dishonesty or fraud under state or federal law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any felony, or of any crime in which dishonesty or fraud is an element, under the laws of any state or of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew authority to practice as a CPA or public accountant in any state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew the authority to practice as a certified public accountant or a public accountant in any state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency or the PCAOB
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency or the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board or its successor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct discreditable to the accounting profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conduct discreditable to the accounting profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to respond to a board inquiry regarding any licensing or complaint matter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to respond to a board inquiry regarding any licensing or complaint matter

definition_quote.value: "Regulated activities" means the offering to perform or the performance for a client or potential client by a person or firm holding a license issued under this chapter of one (1) or more types of services involving the use of accounting, attest, or compilation services, including the issuance of reports on financial statements, or one (1) or more types of management advisory, financial advisory, or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters.
definition_quote.quote: "Regulated activities" means the offering to perform or the performance for a client or potential client by a person or firm holding a license issued under this chapter of one (1) or more types of services involving the use of accounting, attest, or compilation services, including the issuance of reports on financial statements, or one (1) or more types of management advisory, financial advisory, or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters.

value: accounting, attest, or compilation services, including the issuance of reports on financial statements
management advisory, financial advisory, or consulting services
preparation of tax returns or furnishing of advice on tax matters
methods_authorized.quote: services involving the use of accounting, attest, or compilation services, including the issuance of reports on financial statements, or one (1) or more types of management advisory, financial advisory, or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters

value: Any audit or other engagement subject to AICPA Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS) and Government Auditing Standards
Any review of a financial statement subject to AICPA Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS)
Any examination of prospective financial information subject to AICPA Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE)
Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board Auditing Standards
Any examination, review, or agreed-upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the SSAE
attest_services_types.quote: "Attest service" means providing the following services: (a) Any audit or other engagement subject to and to be performed in accordance with the current versions of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA) Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS), and Government Auditing Standards issued by the United States Government Accountability Office; (b) Any review of a financial statement subject to and to be performed in accordance with the current versions of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA) Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS); (c) Any examination of prospective financial information or other professional services to be performed in accordance with the current versions of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA) Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE); (d) Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board Auditing Standards; and (e) Any examination, review, or agreed-upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the SSAE

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "Peer review" means a practice monitoring process designed to promote quality in attest and compilation services

education_semester_hours_required.quote: Completes one hundred fifty (150) college semester hours that include a baccalaureate or masters degree conferred by a college or university recognized by the board

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: Is not required to provide notice of offering or providing such services to the board

value: Submit to the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board
Comply with the provisions of this chapter and the administrative regulations of the board
Cease exercising the privilege if the license issued by the board or agency located in the state of the person's principal place of business expires or is no longer valid
Appointment of the state board or agency where the person's principal place of business is located as agent upon whom process may be served
Notify the board prior to opening any office in this state and immediately apply for a license under KRS 325.280
Notify the board immediately if the person's license in the state where his or her principal place of business is located becomes inactive, lapses, or is subjected to any disciplinary action
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: A person who offers to perform or performs a regulated activity in person or by mail, telephone, or other electronic means in this state pursuant to this section agrees to: (a) Submit to the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board; (b) Comply with the provisions of this chapter and the administrative regulations of the board; (c) Cease exercising the privilege if the license issued by the board or agency located in the state of the person's principal place of business expires or is no longer valid; (d) The appointment of the state board or agency where the person's principal place of business is located and which issued the person's license as the agent upon whom process may be served

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: A person who qualifies for the practice privilege under this section and offers to perform or performs one (1) or more of the following services for a client with its home office located in this state or for a person who is a resident of this state shall perform the service or services through a firm which has obtained a license issued under KRS 325.301

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: Certified public accountants shall hold fifty-one percent (51%) or more of the ownership of the firm in terms of financial interests and voting rights of all partners, officers, shareholders, members, or managers of the firm

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: All owners of the firm who are not certified public accountants shall be natural persons actively engaged in the firm's operations and shall satisfy additional requirements established by the board through promulgation of an administrative regulation

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: All firms that perform attest or compilation services shall enroll in, schedule, undergo, and complete its peer review in an approved peer review program

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: The proceedings, records, and workpapers of the sponsoring organization shall be privileged and not subject to discovery, subpoena, or other means of legal process, or introduction into evidence in any civil action, arbitration, administrative proceeding, or state accountancy board proceeding.

retired_license_status_available.quote: The board may reduce or waive the license to practice renewal requirements upon written request of the licensee showing illness, extreme hardship, or age and retirement from practice

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A firm which does not have an office in this state that performs services described in KRS 325.220 for a client having its home office located in this state or a client who is a resident of this state shall not be required to obtain a license to practice in this state

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: Any individual licensee and any individual qualifying for a practice privilege under this chapter who is responsible for supervising attest services and signs or authorizes someone to sign the report on behalf of the firm shall meet the competency requirements established by the board through promulgation of an administrative regulation

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: A licensee shall not, without the consent of his client, disclose any confidential information pertaining to his client obtained in the course of performing professional services.

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: Except as provided in subsection (1) of this section or pursuant to an agreement entered into between a licensee and his client, all statements, records, schedules, working papers, and memoranda prepared by a licensee to or in the course of providing services to a client shall be the property of the licensee.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: Nonlicensees may use safe harbor language provided in 201 KAR 1:180 in connection with a compilation of financial information.

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: The board may issue a license to practice the regulated activities without examination to an applicant who holds a valid license to engage in the practice of the regulated activities in good standing from a foreign country

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: In any such action evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by this chapter shall be sufficient to justify an injunction or a conviction without evidence of a general course of conduct.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: Any firm with an office located in this state performing attest services, as defined in KRS 325.220

cpa_emeritus_or_retired_status_available.quote: Persons registered with the board as "public accountants" by July 1, 1946, shall receive the designation of "Public Accountant Emeritus" and shall be exempt from the payment of licensing fees and the reporting of continuing education hours.

client_records_return_obligation.quote: Upon request and reasonable notice, the licensee shall furnish to his client or former client any accounting or other records belonging to the client that were provided to the licensee by or on behalf of the client.
